paper.title: Observation of quantum entanglement with top quarks at the ATLAS detector

result.summary: 本文报告了在大型强子对撞机上利用 ATLAS 探测器收集的质心能量 13 TeV、积分亮度 140 fb⁻¹ 的质子-质子碰撞数据，在顶夸克-反顶夸克对中观测到自旋纠缠 [abstract]。研究通过测量由顶夸克静止系中带电轻子夹角推断的单一观测量 D 来探测纠缠，并在顶夸克对产生阈值附近的窄区间内进行测量 [abstract]。在 340 < m_{t\bar{t}} < 380 GeV 区间，测得 D = −0.537 ± 0.002 (stat.) ± 0.019 (syst.)，与无纠缠情景相差超过五个标准差 [abstract]。这是首次在夸克对中观测到纠缠，也是迄今最高能量的纠缠观测 [abstract]。原文指出，该观测展示了利用高能对撞机检验量子力学基本理解的潜力 [S1.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是在最高可及能量尺度上探测量子纠缠，此前纠缠在这一尺度上基本未被探索 [abstract]。原文指出，顶夸克因其独特性质被提出作为研究量子纠缠与量子信息的新实验室 [S1.p2]。研究动机还包括：除在新环境中探索量子纠缠的基础兴趣外，该观测展示了利用 LHC 等高能对撞机检验量子力学基本理解的潜力 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: However, entanglement remains largely unexplored at the highest accessible energy scales.
Recently, the heaviest fundamental particle known to exist, the top quark, was proposed as a new laboratory to study quantum entanglement and quantum information.
this observation demonstrates the potential of using high-energy colliders, such as the LHC, as tools for testing our fundamental understanding of quantum mechanics

method.text: 论文利用顶夸克与反顶夸克之间的自旋关联来探测量子纠缠效应 [S1.p2]。纠缠通过测量单一观测量 D 来探测，D 由顶夸克和反顶夸克静止系中带电轻子之间的夹角推断 [abstract]。D 定义为 D = tr[C]/3，可实验测量为 D = −3·⟨cos φ⟩，其中 ⟨cos φ⟩ 是带电轻子方向经洛伦兹变换到 t\bar{t} 静止系及其母顶夸克静止系后夹角余弦的平均值 [S1.p9]。若测量满足 D < −1/3，则证明存在纠缠态 [S1.p9]。测量在由稳定粒子定义的基准相空间中进行，以最小化蒙特卡洛事件产生器和部分子簇射模型在模拟顶夸克对产生时局限所带来的不确定性 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: the spin correlation between the top quark and antitop quark is used to probe the effects of quantum entanglement
Spin entanglement is detected from the measurement of a single observable D D , inferred from the angle between the charged leptons in their parent top- and antitop-quark rest frames.
It is more convenient to define an entanglement marker by using $D=\textrm{tr}[\mathbf{C}]/3$
The existence of an entangled state is demonstrated if the measurement satisfies $D<-1/3$

It is reported in a fiducial phase space defined with stable particles to minimize the uncertainties that stem from limitations of the Monte Carlo event generators and the parton shower model in modeling top-quark pair production.

experiments.text: 测量使用 ATLAS 探测器在 2015–2018 年收集的质心能量 √s = 13 TeV、积分亮度 140 fb⁻¹ 的完整质子-质子碰撞数据集 [S1.SS1.p1]。事件选择要求恰好一个电子和一个缪子且电荷相反，至少两个喷注且至少一个被 b 标记 [S1.SS2.p1]。信号区确定为 340 < m_{t\bar{t}} < 380 GeV，并定义了两个验证区：380 < m_{t\bar{t}} < 500 GeV 和 m_{t\bar{t}} > 500 GeV [S1.SS2.p4]。每个区域的 t\bar{t} 事件纯度超过 90% [S1.SS2.p4]。数据通过基于模拟的校准曲线从探测器水平修正到粒子水平 [S1.SS2.p6]。

evidence.quote: The complete data set of $pp$ collision events at a center-of-mass energy of $\sqrt{s}=$13\text{\,}\mathrm{TeV}$$ collected with the ATLAS experiment during 2015–2018 is used, corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 140 fb -1.
To be selected, events must have exactly one electron and one muon with opposite-sign electric charges.
The optimal mass window for the signal region was determined to be $340<m_{t\bar{t}}<380$ GeV.
Each of the regions has a $t\bar{t}$ -event purity of more than 90%.
We correct the data for detector effects by using a unique calibration curve built for each signal and validation region based on the expected signal model

findings.text: 在信号区 340 < m_{t\bar{t}} < 380 GeV，观测结果为 D = −0.537 ± 0.002 (stat.) ± 0.019 (syst.)，期望值为 −0.470 ± 0.002 (stat.) ± 0.017 (syst.) [S1.SS3.p1]。在两个验证区 380 < m_{t\bar{t}} < 500 GeV 和 m_{t\bar{t}} > 500 GeV，观测值分别为 D = −0.265 ± 0.001 (stat.) ± 0.019 (syst.) 和 D = −0.093 ± 0.001 (stat.) ± 0.021 (syst.) [S1.SS3.p1]。在信号区，相对于纠缠极限的观测和期望显著性均远超五个标准差，且不依赖于用于修正纠缠极限的蒙特卡洛模型 [S1.SS4.p4]。该结果确立了纠缠 t\bar{t} 态的形成，构成首次在夸克-反夸克对中观测到纠缠 [S1.SS4.p4]。

evidence.quote: The observed (expected) results are: $D=-0.537\penalty\ \pm 0.002\penalty\ \text{[stat.]}\pm 0.019\penalty\ \text{[syst.]}\penalty\ (-0.470\pm 0.002\penalty\ \text{[stat.]}\pm 0.017\penalty\ \text{[syst.])\penalty\,$ in the signal region of $340<m_{t\bar{t}}<380$ GeV

$D=-0.265\penalty\ \pm 0.001\penalty\ \text{[stat.]}\pm 0.019\penalty\ \text{[syst.]}\penalty\ (-0.258\pm 0.001\penalty\ \text{[stat.]}\pm 0.019\penalty\ \text{[syst.])\penalty\,$ $D=-0.093\penalty\ \pm 0.001\penalty\ \text{[stat.]}\pm 0.021\penalty\ \text{[syst.]}\penalty\ (-0.103\pm 0.001\penalty\ \text{[stat.]}\pm 0.021\penalty\ \text{[syst.])\penalty\,$ in the validation regions of $380<m_{t\bar{t}}<500$ GeV and $m_{t\bar{t}}>500$ GeV, respectively.

In the signal region, the observed and expected significances with respect to the entanglement limit are well beyond five standard deviations, independently of the MC model used to correct the entanglement limit
This constitutes the first observation of entanglement in a quark–antiquark pair.

limitations.text: 作者指出，在验证区，当前测量精度不允许排除所使用的任何蒙特卡洛设置 [S1.SS4.p2]。作者还指出，在阈值附近，非相对论 QCD 过程（如库仑束缚态效应）会影响 t\bar{t} 事件产生，而蒙特卡洛产生器未考虑这些效应 [S1.SS4.p2]。此外，作者指出蒙特卡洛事件产生器将矩阵元与部分子簇射算法结合的程序在未来 LHC 更高精度的量子信息研究中需要特别关注 [Ax1.SS10.p7]。

evidence.quote: the current precision of the measurements in the validation regions does not allow us to rule out any of the MC setups that were used
close to the threshold, non-relativistic QCD processes, such as Coulomb bound state effects, affect the production of $t\bar{t}$ events and are not accounted for in the MC generators
The procedure used in MC event generators to combine the matrix element with a parton-shower algorithm requires special attention in future higher-precision quantum information studies at the LHC.
